title: Budget Billing Missed Installments and Removal from a Plan
content:
# Budget Billing Missed Installments and Removal from a Plan

**Rule.** An installment under a Budget Billing plan counts as missed when the bill carrying it is still not paid up to the installment the plan's grace period of calendar days after its due date. The plan is removed when the count of missed installments recorded on the plan reaches the plan's number of missed installments to removal, and the deferred balance is settled under the plan's removal settlement terms. Each bill's installment is recorded as missed at most once.

## When an installment is missed

- **Clock.** The clock starts on the due date of the bill carrying the installment, as shown on that bill. The grace period is counted in calendar days after the due date: day one is the calendar day after the due date.
- **Test.** At the close of the last day of the grace period, the payments made against that bill are compared with the installment. Where they are less than the installment, the installment is missed; where they are equal to it or more, it is not.
- **Record.** A missed installment is recorded on the day after the grace period ended, for the unpaid part of the installment.

*Hypothetical timeline, residential plan, grace period 5 calendar days, installment $118, bill due on the 20th of the month:*

| Payments against the bill by the close of the 25th | Missed | Recorded |
|---|---|---|
| $118.00 or more, made on the 25th | No | — |
| $118.00, of which $40.00 was made only on the 26th | Yes — $78.00 was unpaid at the close of the 25th | On the 26th, for $78.00 |
| Nothing | Yes | On the 26th, for $118.00 |

*The same bill on a business plan, grace period 3 calendar days:* the last day of the grace period is the 23rd, and a missed installment is recorded on the 24th.

## When the plan is removed

The count is every missed installment recorded on the plan over its whole life. The plan is removed when the count reaches the plan's number of missed installments to removal — the second missed installment on the three residential plans, the first on the three business plans — and the plan's deferred balance is settled under its removal settlement terms.

| Plan family | Missed installments recorded on the plan | Count reaches the number to removal |
|---|---|---|
| Residential plans | 1 | No — the number is 2 |
| Residential plans | 2 | Yes — the plan is removed |
| Business plans | 1 | Yes — the plan is removed |

## Once per bill

A bill's installment is recorded as missed once at most. A bill whose installment is already recorded as missed adds nothing further to the count, however long it stays unpaid.
